## About
Brush Hour Painting Texas is a painting crew based on Mcmillian Dr in Austin. We help homeowners with the projects that turn out bigger than they looked, from kitchen cabinets to exterior fencing.
Customers who leave reviews tend to mention Prince by name, and one reviewer also thanked Glenn for the work on their railings and fencing. We hold a 5 star rating from 62 Google reviews, and we would like to earn yours.

## Services
- Hand-painted cabinets: Cabinets taken down, hand-painted and rehung.
- Kitchen walls: Fresh paint for kitchen walls, often alongside a cabinet project.
- Exterior railing and fencing: Repainting worn outdoor railing and fencing.

## FAQ
Q: Can you work with a tight budget and timeline?
A: One reviewer who had just bought a home said Prince was mindful of both her budget and her schedule.

Q: Do you work on garages?
A: Yes. One reviewer said the team renovated their garage within 24 hours.

Q: I started painting myself and got in over my head. Can you help?
A: Yes. One homeowner reached out after trying the job herself, and we finished her cabinets and kitchen walls.
